srep-0029-halftone-default-angle.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!-- SREP 29 s1 halftone with no @angle: the screen is at 0 degrees (the schema default), not 45. Adjustment layer, so the effect input is the frame and p is a frame pixel; flat grey 128 source in the rect 64..320 x 64..256. Derivation: tone l=128/255, dot radius r=sqrt(1-l)*0.7071=0.4990 cell (3.99 px); q=R*p/8 with R the identity, cell centre c = 8*(floor(p/8)+0.5); ink black at the dot centre, ground white at the cell corner. Probes: 4x4 ink boxes at the centres of cells (10,10), (30,12), (38,28) = (84,84), (244,100), (308,228), and 1x1 ground pixels at the corners of the same cells; the far cells are 27 periods from the first, so a lattice period off by 1 px moves them by 27 px, outside a dot. The same probes are ground or ink under the 45 degree lattice only by accident (see srep-0029-halftone-angle-45). Engine provenance: measured on rs-scene-render vendor/schema-1.3 build 2d9eb13d (binary sha256 prefix 4be4bebe002bc190), llvmpipe, frame 0 (render -f 0), VM style1; the expected values were derived from the SREP formulas first (script model) and then compared with the render. Proposals until re-verified on the vendoring commit. -->
<scene version="1.2">
<project width="640" height="360" fps="24" duration="1" background="#000000FF"/>
<output id="still" path="out/frame_%04d.png" codec="png-sequence"/>
<materials><material id="m-red" baseColor="#FF0000FF" unlit="true" doubleSided="true"/><material id="m-green" baseColor="#00FF00FF" unlit="true" doubleSided="true"/><material id="m-blue" baseColor="#0000FFFF" unlit="true" doubleSided="true"/><material id="m-yellow" baseColor="#FFFF00FF" unlit="true" doubleSided="true"/></materials>
<composition>
<shape id="s" shape="rect" width="256" height="192" x="64" y="64" fill="#808080FF"/>
<adjustment id="a" effects="e"/>
</composition>
<effects>
<effect id="e" type="halftone" size="8"/>
</effects>
</scene>

srep-0029-halftone-edge.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!-- SREP 29 s1 and rule 1.4: a halftone never paints outside the edge of its source. Four discs of diameter 120 (R=60): three grey (#808080) at (110,100), (320,100), (530,100) halftoned at angle 0 (default), 15 and 45, and one white at (320,270) at angle 0; ink red, ground blue, on black. The disc alpha is 0 beyond R (plus half a pixel of antialiasing), so the output must be transparent there and the frame black. 288 3x3 boxes sit on rings at R+3, R+6 and R+9 px at 24 angles around each disc, each box at least R+1 px from its centre: all black (0,0,0); a single painted pixel gives a mean above 28. The cells of the grey discs straddle the edge at every angle (cell 8 px), which is where the defect showed. Non-vacuity: the white disc has tone 1, dot radius sqrt(1-1)*0.7071 = 0, so its whole interior is the ground: the 64x64 box at its centre is blue (0,0,255) (at most 2 code values of error if the lattice anchor is fractional). Engine provenance: measured on rs-scene-render vendor/schema-1.3 build 2d9eb13d (binary sha256 prefix 4be4bebe002bc190), llvmpipe, frame 0 (render -f 0), VM style1; the expected values were derived from the SREP formulas first (script model) and then compared with the render. Proposals until re-verified on the vendoring commit. -->

srep-0029-selective-color-amount.xml:

Green #00B400 (w=0) is unchanged. A mix in linear light would give G = B = 131 instead of 90. FINDING: the engine measures (180,131,131) for the #B40000 bar where the SREP formula (@amount mixes in display-encoded colour: halves the change) gives (180,90,90); 131 is the linear-light mix; with linearLight=false the engine still measures 131. This case fails on this build by design: the expectation is the SREP's, not the render's. srep-0029-gradient-map-alpha.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!-- SREP 29 s3 gradient-map keeps the alpha of its stops: result alpha = stop alpha * pixel alpha. Map 1 runs from opaque red (offset 0) to transparent red (offset 1), map 2 the reverse; the background is blue (0,0,255) so transparency shows. A black patch maps to offset 0 and a white patch to offset 1 under any luma weights. Map 1: black patch alpha 1 gives red (255,0,0), white patch alpha 0 gives the blue background (0,0,255). Map 2: black patch alpha 0 gives blue, white patch alpha 1 gives red. The SREP's row says the dark end of an opaque-to-transparent map is transparent: by the formula the dark end is the FIRST stop, here opaque; the transparent end is the light end. The case tests both orders. Engine provenance: measured on rs-scene-render vendor/schema-1.3 build 2d9eb13d (binary sha256 prefix 4be4bebe002bc190), llvmpipe, frame 0 (render -f 0), VM style1; the expected values were derived from the SREP formulas first (script model) and then compared with the render. Proposals until re-verified on the vendoring commit. -->
<scene version="1.2">
<project width="640" height="360" fps="24" duration="1" background="#0000FFFF"/>
<output id="still" path="out/frame_%04d.png" codec="png-sequence"/>
